views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Team.team_api_id,
  Team.team_long_name,
  "Match".season,
  -- include match goals for the team both as home and away contexts
  "Match".home_team_goal,
  "Match".away_team_goal
FROM "Team"
JOIN "Match"
  ON Team.team_api_id IN ("Match".home_team_api_id, "Match".away_team_api_id)
views.description: Task: Compute the median value of the highest season goals for each team, where each team's 'highest season goals' is considered as a single numeric value and the median is calculated across those per
